title: Cash Purchases Made While Continuity Coverage Was Missing
content:
Cash purchases made while the continuity coverage was missing are carried into the quantity of a continuity-of-care quantity limit authorization under the Utilization Management Program.

**Rule.** Paper claims for the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit denied because a coverage review was required, with the denial dated within the last 3 months:

| Such denials | Units carried in |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 |
| exactly 1 | 1 |
| none | 0 |

The 3 months end on the grant date: a denial counts when it is dated after the same day of the month three months before the grant date. Only denials of paper claims for the same drug, for the reason that a coverage review was required, count.

## Hypothetical cases (grant date 20 August)

- Two such denials, dated 2 July and 30 July: 3 units.
- One such denial dated 21 May and one dated 19 May: only the 21 May denial is after 20 May, so 1 unit.
- A paper claim for the drug denied for a reason other than a required coverage review: not counted.
